基础输入与操作

数字输入 AsamInputNumber

数字步进、范围、精度、清空值与数字事件。

使用场景 ​

用于数量和有限精度的数值输入。v-model 为 number、null 或 undefined；change 同时提供新值与之前的值。需要格式化文本展示时见 Input。

范围与步进 ​

min/max 控制范围，step 控制步长；stepStrictly 约束为步长倍数。

省略 min/max 时保留固定原生的 Number.MIN_SAFE_INTEGER / Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER 默认边界，提交不安全整数会裁剪到该范围。应用需要其他范围时显式配置边界。

默认安全整数边界

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamInputNumber v-model="value" aria-label="默认安全整数" />
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button">移出焦点以提交</AsamButton>
		<output>{{ JSON.stringify({ value }) }}</output>
		<p class="example-paragraph">
			省略 min/max 时边界为 -9007199254740991 到
			9007199254740991；提交更大或更小的值会裁剪到边界。
		</p>
	</div>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamInputNumber } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamInputNumberSafeIntegersExample' });
const value = ref<number | null | undefined>(1);
</script>
<style scoped>
.example {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

<style scoped>
p:where(.example-paragraph) {
	margin-block: 16px;
	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

范围与步进

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamInputNumber
			v-model="value"
			v-bind="{ class: 'field', 'aria-label': '采购数量' }"
			:min="0"
			:max="20"
			:step="2"
			step-strictly
			@change="(next, previous) => (change = String(previous) + ' → ' + String(next))"
		/>
		<output>数量：{{ value }}；变化：{{ change }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamInputNumberBasicExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamInputNumber } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const value = ref<number | null | undefined>(4);
const change = ref('尚未变化');
</script>

	min-width: 0;
}

}

.field {

精度与清空值 ​

precision 控制小数位；步长小数位不要超过 precision。valueOnClear 明确清空后的值；disabledScientific 禁止科学计数法字符。

精度与清空值

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamInputNumber
			v-model="value"
			v-bind="{ class: 'field', 'aria-label': '单价' }"
			:precision="2"
			:step="0.25"
			:min="0"
			:value-on-clear="0"
			controls-position="right"
			disabled-scientific
		/>
		<AsamInputNumber
			v-model="plain"
			v-bind="{ class: 'field', 'aria-label': '无控制按钮数字' }"
			:controls="false"
			align="left"
		/>
		<output>单价：{{ value }}；普通数值：{{ plain }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

单位与控制图标 ​

prefix/suffix 显示单位；increase-icon/decrease-icon 定义步进图标。实例公开 focus 与 blur。

单位与控制图标

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamInputNumber
			ref="input"
			v-model="value"
			v-bind="{ class: 'field', 'aria-label': '重量' }"
		>
			<template #prefix>重量</template>
			<template #suffix>kg</template>
			<template #increase-icon>
				<Plus style="width: 16px" />
			</template>
			<template #decrease-icon>
				<Minus style="width: 16px" />
			</template>
		</AsamInputNumber>
		<div class="row">
			<AsamButton type="primary" @click="input?.focus()">聚焦数字</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" @click="input?.blur()">失焦数字</AsamButton>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>

const value = ref<number | null | undefined>(8);

四档密度与继承 ​

large / big / default / small 分别为四档密度。显式 size 覆盖继承；省略 size 时按组件、组、表单、ConfigProvider 到 default 解析。通过切换 provider 验证继承响应。

		<div class="row density-row">

				<AsamInputNumber
					:size="size"
					v-bind="{ class: 'field', 'aria-label': size + '尺寸' }"

ASAM 扩展与迁移 ​

四档 size 保持继承；模型使用数字，空值按 valueOnClear 处理，不将字符串模型直接迁入。默认清空与非法格式可产生 null；input、update:modelValue 和 change 的新旧值均如实保留该空值。

数字格式化与解析 ​

formatter 改变显示，parser 解析编辑文本；模型和事件仍保留 number、null 或 undefined。动态切换 formatter 原样交给原生，ASAM 不通过 key 重建输入节点，不修复原生 text/number 切换的选区限制。tabindex 作用于实际 input。

格式化、解析与内部 tabindex

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamInputNumber
			v-model="amount"
			:formatter="formatter"
			:parser="parser"
			:min="0"
			:max="10000"
			:tabindex="7"
			aria-label="格式化金额"
		/>
		<output>数值模型：{{ amount }}；类型：{{ typeof amount }}</output>
		<p class="example-paragraph">
			编辑 $2,345 后提交或失焦，模型为数字 2345。formatter 只改变显示；parser
			移除装饰后再进行范围/精度校验。
		</p>
	</div>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamInputNumberFormatExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamInputNumber } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const amount = ref<number | null | undefined>(1234);
const formatter = (value: string | number) =>
	value === '' ? '' : '$' + String(value).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
const parser = (value: string) => value.replace(/[$,]/g, '');
</script>

空值、非法格式与恢复 ​

省略 valueOnClear 时默认清空为 null，显式配置可使用数字、null、min 或 max。 完整说明。

空值、非法格式与恢复

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamInputNumber
			v-model="value"
			aria-label="默认清空数字"
			@input="record('input', [$event])"
			@update:model-value="record('update', [$event])"
			@change="recordChange"
		/>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="value = 1">恢复为 1</AsamButton>
		<AsamInputNumber
			v-model="amount"
			:formatter="formatter"
			:parser="parser"
			aria-label="非法格式金额"
			@change="recordAmountChange"
		/>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button">提交格式金额</AsamButton>
		<output>{{ JSON.stringify({ value, amount, events }) }}</output>
		<p class="example-paragraph">
			清空默认产生 null；输入非法格式也可产生 null。重新输入数字会从空值恢复，change
			保留新旧值。
		</p>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamInputNumber } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamInputNumberEmits } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamInputNumberNullValuesExample' });
const value = ref<number | null | undefined>(1);
const amount = ref<number | null | undefined>(2);
const events = ref<{ name: string; args: (number | null | undefined)[] }[]>([]);
function record(name: string, args: (number | null | undefined)[]) {
	events.value.push({ name, args });
}
function recordChange(...args: AsamInputNumberEmits['change']) {
	record('change', args);
}
function recordAmountChange(...args: AsamInputNumberEmits['change']) {
	record('amount-change', args);
}
const formatter = (value: string) => (value === '' ? '' : '$' + value);
const parser = (value: string) => value.replace(/[$,]/g, '');
</script>

}

完整输入边界 ​

stepStrictly 保证步长倍数，precision 限定小数位且不能小于 step 的小数位数。 完整说明。

严格步进、精度和输入边界

<template>
	<div class="example">
		<div class="row">
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="disabled">禁用</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="readonly">只读</AsamCheckboxItem>

			v-model="value"

API 阅读方式 ​

下方 API 来自当前公开类型与运行默认值。默认值标为“未知 / 未声明”时，不代表 false、空值或未支持。省略 size 保留祖先上下文继承。省略 disabled 保留表单禁用继承；validateEvent 控制校验事件，不用 disabled 代替。

原生委托与事件记录 ​

下方完整 TS/JS 示例记录模型及事件顺序，并可切换禁用、只读和自动校验状态。 完整说明。

原生委托与事件记录

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<section class="native-comparison">
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="disabled">禁用</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="readonly">只读</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="validateEvent">自动校验</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<p class="example-paragraph">ASAM</p>
		<AsamInputNumber
			v-model="asam"
			:disabled="disabled"
			:readonly="readonly"
			:validate-event="validateEvent"
			aria-label="ASAM 原生委托"
			@update:model-value="(...args) => record('ASAM', 'update:modelValue', ...args)"
			@input="(...args) => record('ASAM', 'input', ...args)"
			@change="(...args) => record('ASAM', 'change', ...args)"
			@blur="(...args) => record('ASAM', 'blur', ...args)"
		/>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="events = []">
			清空事件记录
		</AsamButton>
		<pre>{{ JSON.stringify({ asam, events }, null, 2) }}</pre>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamInputNumber } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamInputNumberNativeDelegationExample' });
const asam = ref<number | null | undefined>(1);
const disabled = ref(false);
const readonly = ref(false);
const validateEvent = ref(true);
const events = ref<{ source: string; event: string; values: unknown[] }[]>([]);

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamInputNumber } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamInputNumberNativeDelegationExample' });

const disabled = ref(false);
const readonly = ref(false);
const validateEvent = ref(true);
const events = ref([]);
function record(source, event, ...values) {

		event,

	});
}

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, defineAsyncComponent, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const options = [
	{ value: 'basic/ts', label: '范围与步进 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'basic/js', label: '范围与步进 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'precision/ts', label: '精度与清空值 (TS)' },

	{ value: 'icons/ts', label: '单位与控制图标 (TS)' },

	{ value: 'sizes/ts', label: '四档密度与继承 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'sizes/js', label: '四档密度与继承 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'format/ts', label: '格式化、解析与内部 tabindex (TS)' },
	{ value: 'format/js', label: '格式化、解析与内部 tabindex (JS)' },
	{ value: 'boundaries/ts', label: '严格步进、精度和输入边界 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'boundaries/js', label: '严格步进、精度和输入边界 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'null-values/ts', label: '空值、非法格式与恢复 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'null-values/js', label: '空值、非法格式与恢复 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'safe-integers/ts', label: '默认安全整数边界 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'safe-integers/js', label: '默认安全整数边界 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'dynamic-state/ts', label: '动态表单状态与无障碍范围 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'dynamic-state/js', label: '动态表单状态与无障碍范围 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'native-delegation/ts', label: '原生委托与事件记录 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'native-delegation/js', label: '原生委托与事件记录 (JS)' }
] as const;
const scenarios = {
	'basic/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'basic/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/js/Demo.vue')),
	'precision/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/precision/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'precision/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/precision/js/Demo.vue')),
	'icons/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/icons/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'icons/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/icons/js/Demo.vue')),
	'sizes/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/sizes/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'sizes/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/sizes/js/Demo.vue')),
	'format/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/format/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'format/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/format/js/Demo.vue')),
	'boundaries/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/boundaries/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'boundaries/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/boundaries/js/Demo.vue')),
	'null-values/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/null-values/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'null-values/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/null-values/js/Demo.vue')),
	'safe-integers/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/safe-integers/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'safe-integers/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/safe-integers/js/Demo.vue')),
	'dynamic-state/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/dynamic-state/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'dynamic-state/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/dynamic-state/js/Demo.vue')),
	'native-delegation/ts': defineAsyncComponent(
		() => import('./examples/native-delegation/ts/Demo.vue')
	),
	'native-delegation/js': defineAsyncComponent(
		() => import('./examples/native-delegation/js/Demo.vue')
	)
};
const selected = shallowRef<keyof typeof scenarios>('basic/ts');
function selectScenario(value: unknown) {
	const option = options.find((option) => option.value === value);
	if (option) selected.value = option.value;
}
const current = computed(() => scenarios[selected.value]);
</script>

<template>

		<AsamInputNumber
			v-model="value"
			aria-label="默认清空数字"
			@input="record('input', [$event])"
			@update:model-value="record('update', [$event])"
			@change="recordChange"
		/>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="value = 1">恢复为 1</AsamButton>
		<AsamInputNumber
			v-model="amount"
			:formatter="formatter"
			:parser="parser"
			aria-label="非法格式金额"
			@change="recordAmountChange"
		/>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button">提交格式金额</AsamButton>
		<output>{{ JSON.stringify({ value, amount, events }) }}</output>
		<p class="example-paragraph">
			清空默认产生 null；输入非法格式也可产生 null。重新输入数字会从空值恢复，change
			保留新旧值。
		</p>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamInputNumber } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamInputNumberEmits } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamInputNumberNullValuesExample' });
const value = ref<number | null | undefined>(1);
const amount = ref<number | null | undefined>(2);
const events = ref<{ name: string; args: (number | null | undefined)[] }[]>([]);
function record(name: string, args: (number | null | undefined)[]) {
	events.value.push({ name, args });
}
function recordChange(...args: AsamInputNumberEmits['change']) {
	record('change', args);
}
function recordAmountChange(...args: AsamInputNumberEmits['change']) {
	record('amount-change', args);
}
const formatter = (value: string) => (value === '' ? '' : '$' + value);
const parser = (value: string) => value.replace(/[$,]/g, '');
</script>

			@change="recordChange"

const events = ref([]);
function record(name, args) {
	events.value.push({ name, args });
}
function recordChange(...args) {
	record('change', args);
}
function recordAmountChange(...args) {
	record('amount-change', args);
}
const formatter = (value) => (value === '' ? '' : '$' + value);
const parser = (value) => value.replace(/[$,]/g, '');

			aria-label="ASAM 原生委托"
			@update:model-value="(...args) => record('ASAM', 'update:modelValue', ...args)"
			@input="(...args) => record('ASAM', 'input', ...args)"
			@change="(...args) => record('ASAM', 'change', ...args)"
			@blur="(...args) => record('ASAM', 'blur', ...args)"
		/>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="events = []">
			清空事件记录
		</AsamButton>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamInputNumber } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamInputNumberNativeDelegationExample' });
const asam = ref<number | null | undefined>(1);
const disabled = ref(false);
const readonly = ref(false);
const validateEvent = ref(true);
const events = ref<{ source: string; event: string; values: unknown[] }[]>([]);
function record(source: string, event: string, ...values: unknown[]) {
	events.value.push({
		source,
		event,
		values: values.map((value) => (value instanceof Event ? value.type : value))
	});
}
</script>

# AsamInputNumber 全部场景

Node22.19+的22.x、pnpm11.9.0。在本目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor为固定正常包，保留锁文件和patches，不引用网站源码或借用node_modules。

界面中的场景选择器列出本组件全部真实TS/JS用法。src/examples/<场景>/<语言>/保留各场景原文件名、相对导入和资产；文件没有拼接进Demo.vue。主入口与所有场景配置也在文档的完整工程文件面板中。选择另一个场景会卸载前一个实例；文档中只切源文件则不会重挂载。

演示许可与第三方说明位于LICENSE、THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md及来源文件同目录的LICENSE-<摘要>.txt。

## Component compatibility sources and build helpers

Cascader, Image, ImageViewer and Anchor delegate their basic public behavior to
the installed Element Plus 2.14.7 components. ASAM supplies its styles and
documented advanced value adapters; it does not carry derived setup/render
implementations, bounded zoom, keyboard focus patches or Anchor scroll handling.

The former compatibility implementations used Element Plus gitHead
`77d5c32c4ebcfffde67e51f6325c6d350ca668a0`. Their original source identities
are retained here for historical provenance: the Cascader distribution module
SHA256 was `bac94ed4602841106d134f39056fdaca0d7fbb711fc8ff4339b7fac65391ea82`;
Anchor source `packages/components/anchor/src/anchor.vue` SHA256 was
`3a60f68d455f3e582ecffd4639c78ee24fcbf0a2bcfe0ce0cddf03583d78af2f`.
These historical identities do not imply that the derived runtime remains in
this native-delegation candidate. The original Element Plus license follows.

Build helper inputs are pinned to VueUse core 15.0.0, Element Plus Icons Vue
2.3.2 and Lodash ES 4.18.1. Other components may still use these helpers;
removing the four derived implementations does not remove their notices.
VueUse shared and metadata 15.0.0 carry the same license text as core. The
following original notices remain applicable to retained source and helper
inputs; the installed Element Plus components and Vue remain peer dependencies.

## Private declaration snapshots

The normal declaration build redistributes 590 Element Plus 2.14.7 ES declarations
and 295 Element Plus Icons Vue 2.3.2 declarations under `dist/_upstream`.
The original declaration and producer-patch hashes, module-path adaptations and
output hashes are recorded in `dist/_upstream/provenance.json` and the build input
`tools/eng-006/upstream-declarations.lock.json`. The fixed Element Plus source
identity is `77d5c32c4ebcfffde67e51f6325c6d350ca668a0`.

Eight Element Plus declarations receive the recorded strong-type corrections.
Relative declaration references use explicit NodeNext extensions. The Color
class, installation key, table placeholder key and loading directive declaration
are exact re-exports of the original peer declaration leaves, preserving private
member and unique-symbol identity. These snapshots have no runtime entry point.

The complete original MIT licenses are redistributed with each declaration
snapshot at `dist/_upstream/element-plus/LICENSE` and
`dist/_upstream/icons-vue/LICENSE`. The Element Plus and Icons Vue copyright and
license texts above also apply to these declaration derivatives. External type
providers remain normal installed dependencies; their declarations are not
copied into these snapshots.

modelValue输入值number | null | undefined—

disabled是否禁用boolean | undefinedfalse
size显式控件密度；省略时继承按钮组、表单和配置提供器。enum"large" | "big" | "default" | "small"完整类型：AsamControlSize | undefined—
controls是否使用控制按钮boolean | undefinedfalse
controlsPosition控制按钮位置enum"" | "right"完整类型："" | "right" | undefined—
valueOnClear当输入框被清空时显示的值enum"max" | "min"完整类型：number | "max" | "min" | null | undefined—
name原生属性string | undefined—
placeholder输入框占位文本string | undefined—
precision数值精度number | undefined—
validateEvent是否触发表单验证boolean | undefinedfalse
ariaLabel原生 aria-label属性string | undefined—
inputmode原生虚拟键盘输入模式。enum"text" | "email" | "search" | "tel" | "url" | "none" | "numeric" | "decimal"完整类型："text" | "email" | "search" | "tel" | "url" | "none" | "numeric" | "decimal" | undefined—
align内部输入文本对齐enum"right" | "left" | "center"完整类型："right" | "left" | "center" | undefined—
disabledScientific是否禁止输入科学计数法字符，例如 e、E。boolean | undefinedfalse

用法与契约补充说明 ​

空值、非法格式与恢复 ​

省略 valueOnClear 时默认清空为 null，显式配置可使用数字、null、min 或 max。 非法格式编辑可能产生 null；重新键入有效数字即可恢复。模型及 update:modelValue、 input、change 的新旧值类型均为 number | null | undefined，不能把 null 当作字符串 或从事件协议中删除。

完整输入边界 ​

stepStrictly 保证步长倍数，precision 限定小数位且不能小于 step 的小数位数。min/max 在提交时限定范围；valueOnClear 指定清空后的值。disabled、readonly、controls、controlsPosition 分别控制禁用、只读、按钮显示和按钮位置。disabledScientific 禁止键盘 e/E，业务仍应校验数据。

动态表单状态与无障碍范围 ​

disabled、min/max 的更新委托 底层输入。2.14.7 原生在挂载时初始化部分 ARIA 属性，后续动态更新可能仍显示旧的 aria-disabled/aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax。ASAM 保留这一兼容限制，不使用 MutationObserver 改写属性，也不以重挂载恢复选区。

原生委托与事件记录 ​

下方完整 TS/JS 示例记录模型及事件顺序，并可切换禁用、只读和自动校验状态。省略的基础参数使用原生 defaults；显式 undefined/null/false 原样传入，合法值范围见 API。四档 size 是 ASAM 的视觉桥接；Password 额外固定 type=password，并在省略 showPassword 时启用显隐入口。

关联组件

单行输入 AsamInput基础表单 AsamBaseForm全局配置 AsamConfigProvider
